title: Finance Term Absorption Schedule for Trade-In Roll-Ins
content:
The longer the buyer's Kestrel financing runs, the smaller the share of negative equity a **Trade-In Agreements** roll-in absorbs. The term absorption share is read from the term of the contract under **Kestrel Auto Finance Retail Installment Contracts** on the purchase the trade is applied to, taken as the number of monthly installments on that contract.

| Finance contract term | Term absorption share |
|---|---|
| 72 months or more | 0.7 |
| At least 60 months but shorter than 72 months | 0.85 |
| Shorter than 60 months | One (no reduction) |

The share multiplies the negative equity rolled in. It acts once on that amount, before the amount is held to no more than the finance tier's maximum negative equity and before the rounding to the nearest cent.

## Boundaries

| Term | Share |
|---|---|
| 59 months | One |
| 60 months | 0.85 |
| 71 months | 0.85 |
| 72 months | 0.7 |

## Worked example (hypothetical figures)

Negative equity of $2400.00 on a trade whose linked purchase is financed over 75 months: $2400.00 multiplied by 0.7 is $1680.00. With a hypothetical tier maximum negative equity of $1500.00, the amount is held to $1500.00.
